#!/bin/bash

# Deploy branches to web directories
# This hook runs after a push is received

REPO_DIR="/git/project"
MAIN_DIR="/var/www/main"
DEV_DIR="/var/www/dev"

# Create temporary working directories for deployment
TEMP_MAIN=$(mktemp -d)
TEMP_DEV=$(mktemp -d)

# Deploy main branch
git --git-dir="$REPO_DIR" archive main | tar -x -C "$TEMP_MAIN" 2>/dev/null
if [ $? -eq 0 ]; then
    rm -rf "$MAIN_DIR"/*
    cp -r "$TEMP_MAIN"/* "$MAIN_DIR/" 2>/dev/null
fi
rm -rf "$TEMP_MAIN"

# Deploy dev branch
git --git-dir="$REPO_DIR" archive dev | tar -x -C "$TEMP_DEV" 2>/dev/null
if [ $? -eq 0 ]; then
    rm -rf "$DEV_DIR"/*
    cp -r "$TEMP_DEV"/* "$DEV_DIR/" 2>/dev/null
fi
rm -rf "$TEMP_DEV"

# Ensure permissions
chmod -R 755 "$MAIN_DIR" "$DEV_DIR" 2>/dev/null
